purpose: Teach: 附帯/インテリジェンス/ウェブページ/所信/タイマー/ハンディ/モデリング/クリアー

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、附帯捜査も丁寧におこなわれますね
lines.en: The police really do conduct thorough follow-up investigations, don't they.
lines.style: Steady, observational tone. Light appreciative nod in the voice. Speaking as though commenting on something competently done. Conversational rhythm, no urgency.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、インテリジェンス情報の収集もされますね
lines.en: And they gather intelligence information quite systematically too.
lines.style: Continuing the same measured observation. Building on the previous point without emphasis. Warm acknowledgment of professional work. Calm, almost gentle pace.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯ウェブページを更新されますね
lines.en: They keep their crime prevention webpage updated regularly as well.
lines.style: Still in the same reflective mode. Slight emphasis on 'regularly' to show attention to detail. Speaking with quiet approval. No pressure or insistence in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新長官の所信を市民に伝えられますね
lines.en: And they communicate the new chief's statement to the public so clearly.
lines.style: Warm recognition of public-facing work. Slight lift on 'clearly' — noticing good communication. The tone of someone who sees effort and mentions it. Steady and present.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、爆発物のタイマーを解除されますね
lines.en: They even handle bomb disposal work with such care.
lines.style: A quieter moment here — slight respect in the voice for dangerous work. Speaking with genuine solemnity without being heavy. Deliberate pace, weight on 'care'.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、ハンディ無線で連絡を取られますね
lines.en: And they maintain communication through handheld radios across operations.
lines.style: Back to the steady, factual observation. Noticing the practical systems in place. Warm but detached. The tone of someone who appreciates good systems thinking.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯人モデリング技術を活用されますね
lines.en: They put suspect profiling techniques to good use, don't they.
lines.style: Thoughtful recognition of sophisticated methods. Speaking with slight admiration for modern approaches. Measured pace, conversational lift at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、長年の未解決事案をクリアーされますね
lines.en: And they've managed to solve long-standing cold cases too.
lines.style: A warmth that deepens here — quiet satisfaction in voice. Speaking as though moved by persistence paying off. Slightly slower pace. Gentler, more personal register than the others.
